no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Turn words into the vector a picture model (CLIP ViT-B-32, OpenAI weights) gives pictures that show them, to compare with picture vectors kept for recordings", and give it texts.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:words-as-picture-vector and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Encodes 1 to 64 short texts with the CLIP ViT-B-32 text model (OpenAI weights, ONNX export pinned by BLAKE3) and returns one unit-length 512-number vector per text, with the model named, so it is compared only with picture vectors made by the same model.
